caption: The drawing features a large central depiction of a metallic tankard or mug with a wide body that curves inward around the middle, a flared rim and base, and a single ornate handle on the left side. The illustration uses gradients of grey shading to convey the cylindrical form and metallic texture. Three smaller diagrams, one in each lower corner and one in the center bottom, provide orthographic views and dimensional details. The bottom left inset shows a side and outline of the handle with specific measurements. The bottom center inset displays a circular base view of the mug. The bottom right inset shows a simplified profile of the mug with numeric measurements indicating its height and width. The artist’s signature, “MEYERS,” is inscribed in small text below the handle. The paper appears aged, in tones of tan and cream. The main drawing is enclosed in a rectangular border with the supplementary diagrams each in their own smaller borders.
title: Pewter Tankard
